During the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], the [[Je'daii Order]] [[Force vision/Legends|foresaw]] that the forces of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] would strike at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]], and therefore countered [[Sub-Predor]] [[Ceh'let]]'s '''attack''' with one of their own. Numerous [[Je'daii]], led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Daegen Lok]], ambushed the [[Flesh Raider]]s sent to attack [[Ryo Fortress]], the command center from which General [[Rajivari]] was commanding the joint forces of the Je'daii and the [[Settled Worlds]]. Losing over half of her forces, Ceh'let was forced to withdraw back to the Rakatan stronghold on [[Ska Gora]].
